title: 挪威里菲爾克隧道~Ryfylke Tunnel
focus: 深海低點、水壓與抽排韌性~Deep subsea low point, water pressure and drainage resilience
summary: 挪威公路管理局2019年開通紀錄列里菲爾克隧道14.4公里、最低點在海面下292公尺。本課把幾何深度與測壓水頭分開，再研究裂隙封水、支護、低點集水、供電、坡道行車與跨孔撤離；不把海面下深度直接當成所有岩體孔壓或襯砌設計壓力。~The Norwegian road authority records Ryfylke opening in 2019, at 14.4 km with a low point 292 m below sea level. This course distinguishes geometric depth from piezometric head, then examines fracture sealing, support, low-point drainage, power, road gradients and cross-bore evacuation without treating depth as universal pore or lining pressure.

units.anchor: 路線里程與端點~Alignment chainage and endpoints
units.title: 服務邊界與路線代價~Service boundaries and alignment cost
units.mechanism: 里菲爾克深海低點使路線包含長坡，教材比較同端點行程時另列坡度及車輛差異。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。~The deep low point creates long grades; compare travel between equal endpoints while separately retaining slope and vehicle differences. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk. Compare options between identical endpoints and distinguish running bores, approaches and service galleries. Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground.
units.model: 原創教學假設：長度=20.8 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=20.8 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為22.88 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: length=20.8 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=20.8 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 22.88 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 把縱斷面低點和車速假設標在路線圖。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Mark the low point and assumed speed on the longitudinal route. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 同長度平路時間不能代表長坡重車實際行程。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。~Equal-length level-road time does not represent heavy vehicles on long grades. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison.
units.misconception: 最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。~The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
units.practice: 本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：把縱斷面低點和車速假設標在路線圖。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。~For Ryfylke Tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Mark the low point and assumed speed on the longitudinal route. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.

units.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓~Piezometric head and lining pressure
units.mechanism: 海下292公尺是公開幾何位置，本課壓力模型另用假想測壓水頭，避免把兩者無條件相等。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。~The published 292 m depth is geometry; the pressure model uses a separate hypothetical head rather than equating them automatically. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design.
units.model: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=119 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1167.39 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1284.13 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=119 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1167.39 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1284.13 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 以裂隙連通、孔壓和潮位資料檢查水頭邊界。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Check head boundaries using connectivity, pressure and tide data. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 幾何深度不能單獨證明排水後每個位置的實際外壓。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。~Depth alone cannot establish drained external pressure at every location. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground.
units.misconception: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。~No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
units.practice: 本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：以裂隙連通、孔壓和潮位資料檢查水頭邊界。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。~For Ryfylke Tunnel, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Check head boundaries using connectivity, pressure and tide data. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.

units.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新~Fault connectivity and forecast updating
units.mechanism: 海底岩盤裂隙可形成集中補注，教材研究先進孔出水衰減與持續海水連通的不同解釋。斷層帶可以含很硬的岩塊，但整體變形與湧水常由填充節理和連通裂隙控制。單一岩芯強度不能代表整個掌子面；超前鑽孔、出水變化與揭露地質須回饋同一里程模型，預報則應保留不同情境及其證據權重。~Subsea fractures can focus recharge; distinguish probe-flow decay from evidence of continuing sea connection. A fault zone may contain strong intact blocks while filled joints and connected fractures govern its bulk deformation and inflow. One core strength does not represent the entire face. Probe records, water response and exposed geology must update a common chainage model, preserving competing interpretations and their evidential weight rather than treating a forecast as certainty.
units.model: 原創教學假設：滲透係數=3e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.2 無因次；通水面積=420 m²。Q=k i A=0.002772 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0030492 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=3e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.2 dimensionless; flow area=420 m². Q=k i A=0.002772 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0030492 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 比較壓力回復、鹽度與流量時序而非只看瞬間水量。將岩心回收、裂隙方位與出水曲線按里程對齊，用未參與建模的孔段作交叉檢驗，檢查是否只擬合已知資料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare recovery, salinity and flow histories rather than one instantaneous rate. Align recovery, fracture orientation and inflow by chainage; test the interpretation against a withheld borehole interval to detect fitting only the known observations. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 暫時衰減可能是孔內儲水釋放，不能當補注切斷。只用完整岩石強度會漏掉軟弱填充物，可能在看似堅硬的地層中出現收斂加快、支護過載或水量突增。~Temporary decline may be local storage release rather than disconnected recharge. Intact strength alone misses weak infill, allowing accelerating convergence, support overload or sudden inflow in ground that superficially appears strong.
units.misconception: 岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。~Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
units.practice: 本案「破碎帶連通性」的交付需回答：比較壓力回復、鹽度與流量時序而非只看瞬間水量。每次地質模型更新保留舊版與新增證據，差異由地質及支護設計者共同判讀，施工條件改變需重新確認核准範圍。~For Ryfylke Tunnel, the fault-zone connectivity handover must address the following evidence: Compare recovery, salinity and flow histories rather than one instantaneous rate. Retain previous interpretations and new evidence at every update; geology and support designers jointly interpret differences and reconfirm approved bounds when ground conditions change.

units.anchor: 同條件入流減量~Equal-condition inflow reduction
units.title: 裂隙封水與試驗前後比較~Fracture sealing and before-after testing
units.mechanism: 里菲爾克假想封水試段需用注前後水理證據檢查效果，注量大不等於裂隙全被填滿。岩體灌漿意在改變連通裂隙的水力傳導，注入體積不等於留下的有效封水體積。比較前後入流必須保持壓力、水頭和試段邊界一致，否則自然衰減或排水重分配也會降低讀值；灌漿效果要由水力試驗、鄰孔反應和後續揭露共同驗證。~A hypothetical sealing trial needs before-and-after hydraulic evidence; high take does not mean every fracture is filled. Rock grouting changes hydraulic conductance of connected fractures, and injected volume is not retained effective sealing volume. Before-and-after flow must use equal pressure, head and test boundaries; natural decay or redirected drainage can also reduce the reading. Hydraulic tests, neighbouring-hole response and later exposure jointly establish the interpretation rather than injection quantity alone.
units.model: 原創教學假設：試前同壓流量=0.0164 m³/s；試後同壓流量=0.0052 m³/s。r=100(Qbefore−Qafter)/Qbefore=68.2927 %。僅把試後同壓流量增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為65.122 %。邊界：相同水頭與試段的流量減量，不是全岩體封水率或長期保證；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: flow before at equal pressure=0.0164 m³/s; flow after at equal pressure=0.0052 m³/s. r=100(Qbefore−Qafter)/Qbefore=68.2927 %. Increasing only flow after at equal pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 65.122 %. Boundary: Flow reduction at equal head and test interval, not whole-rock sealing efficiency or long-term assurance. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 比較同壓試驗及鄰孔反應，保留材料凝結條件。重複相同水頭和試段長度的水力試驗，同步觀察鄰孔壓力與出水，保存注漿歷程和試驗時間。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare equal-pressure tests and neighbouring responses with setting conditions recorded. Repeat tests at equal head and interval length, observe neighbouring pressure and flow and preserve injection histories and test timing. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 遠端流失可能讓近區試段仍有未封閉的主水路。注漿流入遠端裂隙或形成局部封口，可能使單孔出水減少但主水路仍連通；改變測試水頭也會造成假性改善。~Distant grout loss can leave the dominant local water path open. Grout entering distant fractures or sealing only a collar can reduce one outlet while the main path remains connected; changed test head also creates apparent improvement.
units.misconception: 單孔流量下降就能證明整個掌子面已永久封水。~Reduced flow at one hole proves permanent sealing of the entire face.
units.practice: 本案「同條件入流減量」的交付需回答：比較同壓試驗及鄰孔反應，保留材料凝結條件。把注入量、同條件水力結果和未覆蓋區分開交付，任何封水判斷保留替代水路及後續確認需求，不以教材減量當現場允收。~For Ryfylke Tunnel, the equal-condition inflow reduction handover must address the following evidence: Compare equal-pressure tests and neighbouring responses with setting conditions recorded. Hand over injection quantity, equal-condition hydraulic results and untested areas separately, retaining alternative paths and follow-up checks rather than using classroom reduction as field acceptance.

units.anchor: 支護安裝時點~Support activation time
units.title: 支護啟動與變形容量~Support activation and deformation capacity
units.mechanism: 深海孔的岩體支護與防水功能分開，教材研究節理塊體穩定而仍有高滲流的情境。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。~Separate rock support from waterproofing; stable joint blocks can coexist with significant seepage. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces. Interpret ground-reaction and support curves together with distance from the face and closure sequence. Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response.
units.model: 原創教學假設：局部剛度=52 kN/mm；位移=9 mm。F=ku=468 kN。僅把位移增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為514.8 kN。邊界：線性局部彈簧，不含屈服或時間效應；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=52 kN/mm; movement=9 mm. F=ku=468 kN. Increasing only movement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 514.8 kN. Boundary: Local linear spring without yielding or time effects. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 把塊體位移、錨固荷重與流量各自量測。同步記錄收斂、支護荷重與安裝里程，比較同一地質分區內的速率及荷載，不將不同開挖齡期讀值直接混合。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Measure block movement, anchor force and flow separately. Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 位移小不能當作封水成功，也不能由漏水推定支護失效。過晚封閉會讓不可回復變形增加，過硬且行程不足的支護也可能脆裂，兩者都可能表現為裂縫而需不同處理。~Small movement does not prove sealing, and leakage alone does not prove support failure. Late closure increases irreversible movement, while excessively stiff support with little travel can fail brittly; both produce cracks but require different diagnoses.
units.misconception: 支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。~Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
units.practice: 本案「支護安裝時點」的交付需回答：把塊體位移、錨固荷重與流量各自量測。把安裝時間和量測資料一起交付支護設計者，任何級別變更都需地質及位移證據，不能憑單一瞬間讀值自行改支護。~For Ryfylke Tunnel, the support activation time handover must address the following evidence: Measure block movement, anchor force and flow separately. Submit installation times with measurements to the support designer; class changes need both ground and movement evidence, not an isolated instantaneous reading.

units.anchor: 襯砌環向壓縮~Lining hoop compression
units.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度~Ring force and joint flexibility
units.mechanism: 防水襯砌和噴覆支護的作用需依斷面釐清，教材薄環式僅對假想連續圓形襯砌適用。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。薄環膜應力只說明其中一條受力路徑；脫模、運輸、頂推及永久狀態的荷載不同，環片局部接觸與止水條件必須另外檢核。~Clarify waterproof lining and sprayed-support functions; the thin-ring exercise applies only to a hypothetical continuous circular lining. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending. Thin-ring membrane stress describes only one load path. Demoulding, transport, jacking and permanent states impose different actions, requiring separate checks of local segment contact and sealing rather than one permanent-load calculation.
units.model: 原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.74 MPa；半徑=3.5 m；厚度=0.35 m。σθ=pr/t=7.4 MPa。僅把均勻外壓增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為8.14 MPa。邊界：薄圓環膜應力，不是接縫、偏壓或矩形框架解；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.74 MPa; radius=3.5 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=7.4 MPa. Increasing only uniform external pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 8.14 MPa. Boundary: Thin circular-ring membrane stress, not a joint, uneven-load or rectangular-frame solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 核對實際結構型式後再決定是否可用環向模型。將環形變形、接縫張開與應變和含接頭彈簧的模型比較，分開安裝後、背填後及水頭回升後的基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Check structural form before deciding whether a hoop model applies. Compare ring distortion, joint opening and strain with a joint-spring model, separating baselines after installation, grouting and head recovery. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 把非連續防水系統當完整承壓環會虛構受力路徑。局部脫空增加環片彎曲，裂縫未必代表混凝土平均強度不足；忽略接縫接觸會把補強方向導向錯誤位置。~Treating a discontinuous waterproof system as a pressure ring invents a load path. Local voids increase bending, so cracks need not indicate inadequate mean concrete strength; neglecting joint contact can misdirect strengthening.
units.misconception: 混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。~Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
units.practice: 本案「襯砌環向壓縮」的交付需回答：核對實際結構型式後再決定是否可用環向模型。設計圖應分開標註各施工階段、接頭剛度及背填條件，構件驗收同時核對幾何、材料批次與止水試驗適用包絡。~For Ryfylke Tunnel, the lining hoop compression handover must address the following evidence: Check structural form before deciding whether a hoop model applies. Drawings distinguish stages, joint stiffness and backfill conditions; component acceptance reconciles geometry, material batches and the applicable sealing-test envelope.

units.anchor: 剩餘集水容積~Remaining sump volume
units.title: 停泵緩衝與有效集水容積~Outage buffer and effective sump volume
units.mechanism: 深低點集水需保留持續入流和停電條件，里菲爾克教材計算緩衝時間後另驗泵揚程。集水坑在泵停止後提供有限緩衝，剩餘容積需扣除初始水量、沉積及不可用死角。緩衝時間取決於淨入流，不是名牌抽水能力；警報延遲、備援切換與水量突增會消耗餘裕，排水電力又可能與其他安全設備共用失效原因。~Low-point sumps need continuing inflow and power-loss cases; calculate buffer time and separately verify pump head. A sump offers finite buffering after pumps stop, with usable volume reduced by initial water, sediment and dead spaces. Buffer time depends on net inflow rather than pump nameplate capacity. Alarm delay, transfer time and inflow surges consume reserve, while shared electrical dependencies may disable drainage and other safety equipment together.
units.model: 原創教學假設：有效剩餘容積=740 m³；淨入流=0.18 m³/s。t=V/Q/60=68.5185 min。僅把淨入流增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為62.2896 min。邊界：停泵固定入流，不含警報延遲及水量突增；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: usable reserve=740 m³; net inflow=0.18 m³/s. t=V/Q/60=68.5185 min. Increasing only net inflow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 62.2896 min. Boundary: Constant inflow during outage, excluding alarm delay and inflow surges. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 用實測泵流量、出水水頭與集水位上升率互查。以水位容積曲線和流量計核對停泵水位上升率，另檢查淤積、警報時間戳及備援電力切換紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Cross-check pump delivery, discharge head and sump rise rate. Compare outage level-rise rate with the level-volume curve and flowmeter, separately checking sediment, alarm timestamps and backup-power transfer records. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 名目泵流量在高揚程下可能無法實現，緩衝會提早耗盡。未扣除沉積的總容積會高估反應時間，若警報與抽水同失電，操作者可能在緩衝已耗盡後才得知水位上升。~Nominal pump delivery may be unattainable at high head, exhausting reserve early. Gross volume without sediment deduction overstates response time; shared loss of alarm and pumping power can hide rising water until the buffer is exhausted.
units.misconception: 集水坑總容積除以平均入流就是保證可用的反應時間。~Gross sump volume divided by average inflow is a guaranteed response time.
units.practice: 本案「剩餘集水容積」的交付需回答：用實測泵流量、出水水頭與集水位上升率互查。交接有效容積、初始水位及延遲預算，由排水與電氣責任人共同核對故障情境，定期清淤後保存量測證據。~For Ryfylke Tunnel, the remaining sump volume handover must address the following evidence: Cross-check pump delivery, discharge head and sump rise rate. Handover usable volume, initial level and delay budgets; drainage and electrical owners jointly review failures and retain measurements after sediment removal.

units.title: 設備備援與共同失效~Equipment redundancy and common failure
units.mechanism: 深低點抽排的兩泵若共享電源及出口管路，教材不把單機不可用率直接平方當全系統風險。兩套設備只有在故障近似獨立且切換可靠時，並聯才顯著降低不可用率。共用配電、控制軟體、冷卻或受淹位置會把獨立假設破壞；維修停用也改變當下配置，因此可靠度模型必須明列共有資源和設備狀態，不能只數備用台數。~Two sump pumps sharing power and discharge lines do not justify squaring unit unavailability for the whole system. Parallel equipment sharply reduces unavailability only when failures are approximately independent and transfer works. Shared power, software, cooling or flood exposure breaks that assumption. Planned maintenance also changes the available configuration, so reliability models must identify shared resources and states rather than count spare units or multiply unsupported independent probabilities.
units.model: 原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.032 無因次。Uparallel=U²=0.001024 probability。僅把單機不可用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.00123904 probability。邊界：完全獨立並聯與完美切換，不含共同失效；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.032 dimensionless. Uparallel=U²=0.001024 probability. Increasing only single-unit unavailability by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.00123904 probability. Boundary: Independent parallel units with perfect transfer, excluding common failures. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 追查電源、止回和共用管路故障的影響。由設備清單畫出故障樹，將電源、控制及實體位置追到共同節點，並用事件及維修紀錄檢查獨立假設。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Trace effects of power, check-valve and common-pipe failures. Build a fault tree from the asset list, trace power, control and location to shared nodes, and test independence against incident and maintenance records. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 共用出口堵塞會讓兩台正常泵都無法排水。重複安裝卻共用單一供電可能在一次故障中全部停機，帳面可靠度很高但實際不可用時間沒有降低。~A blocked common outlet prevents both healthy pumps from discharging. Duplicated equipment on one supply can fail together in a single event, leaving actual downtime unchanged despite optimistic calculated reliability.
units.misconception: 設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。~Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
units.practice: 本案「系統不可用率」的交付需回答：追查電源、止回和共用管路故障的影響。維修計畫附當日可用配置與剩餘備援，任何共同資源更動同步更新故障樹，切換試驗由設備及營運團隊共同見證。~For Ryfylke Tunnel, the system unavailability handover must address the following evidence: Trace effects of power, check-valve and common-pipe failures. Attach the actual configuration and remaining redundancy to maintenance plans, update fault trees after shared-resource changes, and witness transfer tests jointly.

units.anchor: 風道摩擦壓損~Duct friction loss
units.title: 通風網路與壓力損失~Ventilation network and pressure loss
units.mechanism: 長下坡與上坡車流改變污染源和活塞作用，教材用網路量測辨識風機與車流的相對影響。風機提供壓差，實際風量由風道摩阻、局部損失、外風與其他風機共同決定。支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。~Descending and climbing traffic change emissions and piston effects; use network observations to distinguish traffic from fan influence. Fans supply pressure, but actual flow follows friction, local losses, external wind and interactions with other fans. Switching a branch redistributes the network rather than simply adding rated flows. Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target.
units.model: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1380 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.8 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=74.727 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為90.4197 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=1380 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.8 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=74.727 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 90.4197 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 同時記錄方向車流、風速和壓差，不混用不同時段。沿線同步量測靜壓與風速，記錄風門及其他風機狀態，再把實測工作點和風機曲線、網路壓損比較。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Record directional traffic, velocity and pressure simultaneously. Measure pressure and velocity synchronously, record dampers and other fans, and compare the measured duty point with fan curves and network resistance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 交通方向變化引起的風流不應直接判為風機性能衰退。只看風機轉速會漏掉風門誤位或短路漏風，可能在總耗電增加時，真正需要的區段反而風量不足。~Traffic-induced flow changes should not be labelled fan deterioration directly. Fan speed alone misses a misplaced damper or leakage shortcut; total power may rise while the critical section receives less air.
units.misconception: 風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。~Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
units.practice: 本案「風道摩擦壓損」的交付需回答：同時記錄方向車流、風速和壓差，不混用不同時段。驗收採明確風門和車流邊界，維修改線後重新核對網路工作點，火災模式由防災責任工程師簽認而非沿用正常模式。~For Ryfylke Tunnel, the duct friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Record directional traffic, velocity and pressure simultaneously. Commission with specified damper and traffic boundaries, recheck duty points after rerouting, and have the fire-safety engineer approve emergency modes independently.

units.anchor: 所需疏散時間~Required evacuation time
units.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性~Evacuation time and zone availability
units.mechanism: 深海路線兩端爬升距離長，跨孔路徑與最終出口需求不同，教材分階段計算並檢查鄰孔狀態。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。~Long ascent to portals makes cross-bore transfer distinct from reaching an ultimate exit; calculate stages and check the receiving bore. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit. Smoke, visibility and mobility alter walking speed, while safety requires comparison with available safe time. A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route.
units.model: 原創教學假設：前置時間=124 s；行走距離=380 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=599 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為646.5 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=124 s; travel distance=380 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. RSET=tpre+d/v=599 s. Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 646.5 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 核對轉入鄰孔後的交通控制及後續移動方案。以人流模擬或受控演練分辨前置時間、行走與門口排隊，核對每個出口接收區的可用狀態及通訊紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Check traffic control and onward movement after transfer to the adjacent bore. Separate pre-movement, travel and doorway queues through simulation or controlled drills, checking receiving-zone availability and communication records for each exit. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 到達鄰孔不等於完成所有人員的最終撤離。以最快成人速度套全部旅客會低估需求，若忽略接收孔受煙或車流影響，疏散可能移到另一個危險邊界。~Arrival in the adjacent bore does not complete final evacuation for everyone. Applying the fastest adult speed to everyone understates demand; overlooking smoke or traffic in the receiving bore can transfer evacuees into another hazard.
units.misconception: 只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。~Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
units.practice: 本案「所需疏散時間」的交付需回答：核對轉入鄰孔後的交通控制及後續移動方案。疏散模型保留人口、速度分布及出口狀態，演練改動由營運與防災責任者批准，教材算例不得當作現場指揮程序。~For Ryfylke Tunnel, the required evacuation time handover must address the following evidence: Check traffic control and onward movement after transfer to the adjacent bore. Retain population, speed distribution and exit states; operations and fire-safety owners approve drill changes, and classroom calculations are not incident-command procedures.

example: 原創綜合審查：先計算「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，再獨立計算「環向受力與接縫柔度」。原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=119 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1167.39 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1284.13 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.74 MPa；半徑=3.5 m；厚度=0.35 m。σθ=pr/t=7.4 MPa。僅把均勻外壓增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為8.14 MPa。邊界：薄圓環膜應力，不是接縫、偏壓或矩形框架解；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。~Original integrated review: first calculate piezometric head and lining pressure, then independently calculate ring force and joint flexibility. Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=119 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1167.39 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1284.13 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.74 MPa; radius=3.5 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=7.4 MPa. Increasing only uniform external pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 8.14 MPa. Boundary: Thin circular-ring membrane stress, not a joint, uneven-load or rectangular-frame solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
history: 2019 年公開記錄：里菲爾克隧道於12月30日開放通車。挪威公路管理局2019年開通紀錄列里菲爾克隧道14.4公里、最低點在海面下292公尺。本課把幾何深度與測壓水頭分開，再研究裂隙封水、支護、低點集水、供電、坡道行車與跨孔撤離；不把海面下深度直接當成所有岩體孔壓或襯砌設計壓力。本課把「深海低點、水壓與抽排韌性」視為互相連動的系統，工程年代和名稱由所列公開來源核對；模型中的設備配置、荷載與量測數字另外標明為教學假設，只重建公開原理及工程推理，不是原始設計文件。~Public record for 2019: Ryfylke Tunnel opens to traffic on 30 December. The Norwegian road authority records Ryfylke opening in 2019, at 14.4 km with a low point 292 m below sea level. This course distinguishes geometric depth from piezometric head, then examines fracture sealing, support, low-point drainage, power, road gradients and cross-bore evacuation without treating depth as universal pore or lining pressure. The course treats deep subsea low point, water pressure and drainage resilience as coupled engineering questions. Named events and dimensions follow the listed public sources; equipment scenarios, loads and measurement values are separately marked teaching assumptions. Only public principles and reasoning are reconstructed, not original design documents.
facts: 公開工程尺度約為 14.4 km，保留所列來源的計量邊界。~The public scale is about 14.4 km; retain the measurement boundary in the cited source.
2019 年事件：里菲爾克隧道於12月30日開放通車。~2019 event: Ryfylke Tunnel opens to traffic on 30 December.

教學「路線里程與端點」：長度=20.8 km，其餘輸入依單元，結果=20.8 min；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching alignment chainage and endpoints: length=20.8 km, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 20.8 min; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「測壓水頭」：水密度=1000 kg/m³，其餘輸入依單元，結果=1167.39 kPa；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching piezometric head: water density=1000 kg/m³, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 1167.39 kPa; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「支護安裝時點」：局部剛度=52 kN/mm，其餘輸入依單元，結果=468 kN；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching support activation time: local stiffness=52 kN/mm, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 468 kN; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「襯砌環向壓縮」：均勻外壓=0.74 MPa，其餘輸入依單元，結果=7.4 MPa；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching lining hoop compression: uniform external pressure=0.74 MPa, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 7.4 MPa; not measured or accepted project data.
